Translate "Ayer se estrenó la segunda parte de «Dune», la adaptación de Denis Villeneuve de la novela homónima de Frank Herbert. No son pocos los análisis cinematográficos de la obra que la han tildado de «izquierdista», de poseer una sensibilidad especial hacia causas «progresistas»" Every quoted phrase must be followed by an unquoted explanation.assistant

The second part of "Dune", the adaptation of Denis Villeneuve's novel of the same name by Frank Herbert, premiered yesterday. There are not many film analyses of the work that have labeled it as "leftist", possessing a special sensitivity towards "progressive" causes.

In this context, the phrase "izquierdista" refers to a political or ideological alignment that is often associated with left-wing or progressive views. The term is often used in Latin America to describe political or social movements that are seen as promoting social change and challenging traditional power structures.

The phrase "poseer una sensibilidad especial hacia causas 'progresistas'" means that the work has a special sensitivity towards progressive causes. In this context, "progresistas" refers to individuals or groups who are seen as promoting social change and progress, often through progressive or liberal means.
